open_conditions.item: TVS32V/45V targets are not guaranteed hot pulse measurements
open_conditions.condition: VM≤32V and upstream absolute magnitude≤45V must include overshoot; pulse limits2A,1ms,.05J,.1Hz,initialTVS≤60C apply together.

open_conditions.item: BSS138 speed/capacitance not fully worst-case bounded
open_conditions.condition: TI examples select this part, but onsemi27pF Ciss is typical and RDSon is specified at4.5V, while DRV high minimum3V. Do not claim a guaranteed reverse turn-off nanosecond bound; qualify actual gate waveforms/charge and overshoot.
0.1J/15V requires effectiveC≥2304uF; only4.4mJ to conservative17.766V VMOV threshold. Ripple, cold/life capacitance and actualreturned energy need verification.

open_conditions.item: Motor stall and starting torque remain unknown
open_conditions.condition: Current chopping is not stall-time protection; watchdog detects missing heartbeat, not a stalled motor with live heartbeat. No sustained-stall authorization.

open_conditions.item: Battery voltage/topology and prospective short current unknown
open_conditions.condition: 9–15V is provisional;300A/32V fuse interrupt credit must cover actual source fault current. Listing current claims do not establish this.

open_conditions.item: Paired eFuse power escapes and returns require actual geometry inventory
open_conditions.condition: BothIN pads and bothOUT pads must independently connect with shortfanouts, avoiding an unseen sharedneck. Verify maincurrent vias, FUSED_IN1mm lengths, ground thermal copper and filled/cappedU13holes.

open_conditions.item: Warm recovery and arbitrary brownout remain unmeasured
open_conditions.condition: PGTHhigh recovery may bypassCdVdT; awake current must be included. Verify noautomaticrearm and no slow-edge/partialpower motion.
